pictures.name: SKM1-Alone-In-Hut
pictures.prompt: Inside a small, dim thatched hut in an ancient Indian monastery. a sick monk (thin, pale, shaved head, a worn ochre robe, lying weakly on a simple straw mat) lies on the floor, eyes half open. In the bright doorway behind, the Buddha (shown in the traditional respectful way: serene face, short dark curls, gentle downcast eyes, a simple saffron robe over one shoulder) and Ananda (a gentle-faced, middle-aged Indian monk, shaved head, ochre robe, kind attentive eyes) pause, looking in with concern. A shaft of gold light falls across the earthen floor, deep blue shadows.
